matrix: ordered five FEC14 candidates; each stage/outcome and exact execution count; pending entries unattempted
checkpoint: wall/monotonic/pid/current stage, refreshed at stage changes and during waits

candidate_files.scheduler-change.json: only grant/guard configuration diff and server PID readback
candidate_files.readiness-observations.jsonl: raw status snapshots during the single <=30s readiness window
candidate_files.gate-result.json: last status, exact fail nodes and gate duration
candidate_files.after-audit.json: all participating host probes, raw errors, GET radio/FEC, source/native SHA, 15W and fl04 service check

duration_semantics: DLduration/ULduration are null when no publish/submit was dispatched; transfer_verified=false is not evidence of a measured RF file failure
restore_semantics: restore_ok=false indicates independent full baseline health could not be confirmed; no smoke radio changes occurred
